fr.recommendations:
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective address numbers visible from both directions on the road.
• Trim tree branches and shrubs along both sides of the access drive so emergency vehicles can pass without obstruction.
• Cut back vegetation at the driveway entrance to open sight lines for approaching vehicles turning onto the property.
• Keep the access drive clear of parked vehicles, equipment, and debris so emergency vehicles can reach the structure without delay.
• Install a reflective address sign at the road-to-driveway junction, positioned so it is readable at night and in smoky conditions.
• Thin dense vegetation along the access drive to reduce the risk of fire closing the only entry and exit route.
• Identify and mark a turnaround or staging area on the open terrain so emergency vehicles do not have to back out along the access drive.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim branches on large trees that overhang or touch the house on any side.
• Thin the tree cluster closest to the structure to create open space between individual trees and the house.
• Remove shrubs and ground vegetation growing directly against the base of the house.
• Separate scattered shrubs from the base of any outbuildings or detached structures on the property.
• Clear dead leaves, needles, and loose plant material from the ground around the house.
• Thin mixed vegetation on all sides of the house so there is open ground visible between plants and the structure.
• Trim overhanging branches along the full length of the driveway to keep the travel lane open.
• Cut back shrubs and ground vegetation growing along the driveway edges so a vehicle can pass through without contact.
• Remove or thin scattered trees along the driveway that crowd the travel lane or block sightlines.
• Keep the single access route free of fallen branches, debris, and vegetation that could block emergency vehicle entry or exit.
• Thin ground vegetation between tree clusters and the house so there is no continuous mat of plants connecting the two.
• Remove low-hanging branches from large trees near the house, starting from the ground up.
